services.desc: Myrtle Beach is the perfect place for inshore fishing with its beautiful beaches and fishing spots. Inshore fishing means fishing in estuaries, bays, and tidal creeks. Whether you’re an old pro or a newbie, here’s what you can expect to catch on an inshore fishing charter in Myrtle Beach. Here we share the top fish to catch on an inshore fishing charter on the beautiful South Carolina coast! Flounder is a Myrtle Beach inshore favorite along the sandy bottoms near inlets and estuaries. These flatfish are masters of disguise and lie in wait for prey, so they can be a challenge to catch. Whether you’re living in or visiting Surfside Beach, Fisher of Men Inshore Charters has a great experience ready for you.
